spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ऊ) गुहू (गुहति)
To cover, to cover as with clothes, to wear.

m. (-हः)
1 A name of

KĀRTTIKEYA.
2
A name of VIṢṆ

A swift horse.
4 The name of a Niṣāda, ruler of Sringavera, the friend of

RĀMA.
5

A name or title proper to persons of the writer caste.
f. (-हा)
1 A cave, a cavern.
2 A pit, a hole in the ground.
3 A plant, commonly Cākuliya: see सिंहपुच्छी.
E.
गुह to conceal, affixes अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-हं)
A cavern.
E.
गुहा, and गृह a house.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Wide mouthed, open mouthed.
E.
गुहा, and मुख mouth.

m. (-यः)
1 A tiger.
2 Any animal or man living in caverns.
3 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
गुहा a cave, and आशय abode.

n. (-नं)
A wood, a thicket.
E.
गुह to hide, इनच् aff.

n. (-लं)
Wealth, property.
E.
गुह to hide, &c. इलच् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 An ironsmith.
2 A guardian, a preserver.
E.
गुह to cover, एरक् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 Secret, solitary, retired.
2 Private, concealable, to be kept hidden or secret.
3 Mysterious, mystical.
m. (-ह्यः)
1 A tortoise.
2

Hypocrisy.
3

VIṢṆU.
n. (-ह्यं)
1 A privity, an organ of generation, &c.
2 The anus.
E.
गुह to cover, क्यप् affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A kind of demigod attendant upon KUVERA the deity of wealth, and guardian of his treasures.
E.
गुह to preserve or conceal, affix क्वुन् and य inserted.

m. (-रः)
A name of KUVERA the Hindu PLUTUS.
E.
गुह्यक a demigod, (see the preceding,) and ईश्वर lord or master.

m. (-रुः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
गुह्य secret, and गुरु a master; ŚIVA being considered as the teacher, especially of the Tantras, or Hindu mystic and magical works.

m. (-कः)
The fire fly.
E.
गुह्य a solitary place, and दीपक the illuminer; from दीप to light or inflame, and क्वुन् aff.

m. (-न्दः)
Urine.
E.
गुह्य, and निष्यन्द what flows.

n. (-तं)
1 A Mantra, a mystical prayer or incantation.
2 A secret.
E.
गुह्य secret, and भाषित spoken.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Hiding, concealing.
E.
गुह to hide, शानच् aff.

ind.
Having concealed, hidden, disguised.
E.
गुह to hide, causal form, क्त्वा aff.
